purpose: A CLI Linear Session whose record 2 is drawn in two windows, with a Record Order that names both records by record ID and lists the windowed record first (OV-3313 review 2 H1): the CLI draws REGEX.1's two windows, then TESTA
writer: gbdraw/linear.py --save_session (CLI sidecar), run from the fix/record-order-row-one-rule worktree on PYTHONPATH
command: PYTHONPATH=<worktree> python -c 'from gbdraw.cli import main; main()' linear --gbk b_collide.gb regex_rules.gb --region '#2:1-800' --region '#2:1000-2000' --multi_record_position 'REGEX.1@1' --multi_record_position 'TESTA@1' --save_session -o cli-linear-windows-record-order-ids
workingDirectory: a scratch folder; the inputs are tests/fixtures/b_collide.gb and tests/fixtures/regex_rules.gb
values: drawings[0].renderRequest.layout.multiRecordPositions and the records' windows; no record has a selector (one-record files)
